intent: Count Tavern chat anti-spam messages only from the preceding one minute.
rationale: The rate-limit repository count was bounded by LocalDateTime.now().minusMinutes(5), so messages up to five minutes old were included. Changing only that bound to minusMinutes(1) makes the existing MAX_PER_MINUTE threshold operate on the requested one-minute window without altering other chat behavior.
